profile.headline: Robotics Software Engineer at Path Robotics

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Worked with Kitov.AI to introduce metrology grade visual measurement to their robots
-Lead development of a custom Micro-Vu hardware driver through USB traffic analysis, enabling reliable machine communication, motion and lighting control, and touch sensor integration
-Developed metrology-grade C++ vision algorithms for pattern matching, blob detection, and edge detection using OpenCV, improving performance and efficiency by over 60%
-Created a new efficient algorithm to calculate localized flatness across measured 3D plane data

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-Optimized geometric fitting algorithms through improved memory management, reducing processing time by over 80% while maintaining same level of precision
-Developed line- and circle-based cylinder scanning methods for three- and five-axis measurement machines and wrote Python scripts to filter and visualize measurement data for development and debugging of filters to apply to scanned point cloud data
-Designed and developed an automation application that coordinated PLCs, robots, and CMM-Manager through Modbus communication to automate part inspection cells
-Diagnosed crashes, memory leaks, geometry errors, and hardware issues using logs, XML analysis, and reproducible test cases while supporting quality through UpSource reviews, Jira tracking, documentation, regression testing, and company wide WIKI development

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
-Developed and debugged C++ software in Linux for embedded telematics systems
-Utilized J1939 CAN and SSH to communicate with hardware, send commands, and collect data
-Created simulation, black-box, and regression test plans for radio and embedded software
-Wrote GoogleTest unit tests and presented verification results to architects and customers
-Managed code and project work using Git and Jira while collaborating across time zones
positions.insights: Skills: Software Testing · C++ · Gtest · Communication · Leadership

positions.title: Maintenance
positions.description:
-Collaborated across sales and operations departments to prepare customer contracts 
-Built Excel spreadsheets to analyze historical sales performance and develop future sales projections 
-Performed routine maintenance on company grounds, delivery trucks, and propane tank

positions.title: Maintenance
positions.description:
